entities.summary: Denis Mack Smith was an English historian who specialized in the history of Italy from the Risorgimento onwards. He is best known for his biographies of Garibaldi, Cavour and Mussolini, and for his single-volume Modern Italy: A Political History. He was granted Italy's highest civilian honor in 1996.
